items.name: memory
items.title: Long-term memory (pgvector)
items.description: Semantic long-term memory for an eve agent, stored in your own Postgres with pgvector. No vector service, no extra container, no bill.

items.name: instrumentation
items.title: evestack dashboard traces
items.description: Export OpenTelemetry traces from an eve agent to a self-hosted evestack dashboard.

items.name: docker-sandbox
items.title: Docker sandbox
items.description: Run the agent's sandbox in a local Docker container instead of hosted Vercel Sandbox.

items.name: basic-auth
items.title: HTTP Basic route auth
items.description: Replace vercelOidc()/placeholderAuth() with HTTP Basic, for agents that run off Vercel.

items.name: channel-slack
items.title: Slack channel
items.description: Answer @mentions and DMs in Slack from a self-hosted eve agent. Bot token plus signing secret — no Vercel account and no Connect connector.

items.name: channel-discord
items.title: Discord channel
items.description: Answer Discord slash commands from a self-hosted eve agent. Application public key plus bot token — no Vercel Connect client.

items.name: channel-telegram
items.title: Telegram channel
items.description: Text your self-hosted eve agent from Telegram. One BotFather token, no app review and no workspace admin — the fastest channel to actually finish.
